independent_computation.what_the_leaf_must_be: A dimensionless multiplier > 1 attached to a resistance-reduction entry on a coupled-timeline combat event, i.e. the damage amplification that the roster's supporting participant receives from a resistance-reduction debuff sitting on the target. (A multiplier applied to the resistance itself would be < 1 for a reduction; both old and new values are > 1, so the field is the damage-side amplification.)
independent_computation.step_1_identify_the_source: The only resistance-reduction effect in scenario 'cleaver_bloodsong_roster' is Black Cleaver's Carve (S1). Bloodsong (S3) carries no resistance reduction at all - its Expose Weakness is a flat damage-taken amp of 8% melee / 5% ranged (S7 for the template), i.e. factors 1.08 / 1.05, neither of which is 1.03 or 1.2. Carve is a debuff on the *target*, so it amplifies every damage source on the roster, which is exactly the coupling this scenario exercises.
independent_computation.step_2_formula: Amplification for any participant when the target's armor R is reduced by a fraction p:  factor = m(R*(1-p)) / m(R) = (100 + R) / (100 + R*(1-p)).  m from S4, the percent-reduction step R <- R*(1-r_pct/100) from S5. Black Cleaver adds no penetration (S2), so no max(0, ...) floor or flat term enters.
independent_computation.step_3_target_armor: The scenario's roster target is a champion (Carve only stacks on enemy champions, S1). Level-18/20 champion base armor, computed from data/champions.json with the documented growth formula base + growth*(L-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(L-1)), lands in a broad band; 84 champion/level combinations fall in 119-131 armor (e.g. Aatrox@18 119.6, Braum/Illaoi/Poppy@18 120.0, Malphite@18 124.15, Darius@18 125.4, Sejuani@18 126.65).
independent_computation.step_5_conclusion: Both the old and the new leaf are the SAME formula evaluated at the SAME target armor (any R in ~119-131, exactly 1.200000 at R = 125) and differ only in the Carve stack count credited to the supporting participant: old 1.03 = 1 stack (6% armor reduction), new 1.2 = 5 stacks (30%, the wiki-stated cap in S1). No other combination of the scenario's items reproduces this pair: Bloodsong's amp would be 1.08/1.05, and no reading of 'factor' as 1 + reduction-fraction or 1/(1 - reduction-fraction) matches either number against Carve's 6%/30%.
independent_computation.step_6_which_stack_count_is_right_at_eve: Carve applies a stack on every instance of physical damage to the champion and lasts 6 s, refreshing (S1). By event index 46 of a continuous combat timeline the Cleaver holder has dealt physical damage many times over, so the debuff sitting on the target is at its 5-stack cap: 30% armor reduction, factor 1.20. A single stack (6%) is only correct for the very first physical hit of the fight, so 1.03 at event 46 credits the support with a debuff strength the target has long since exceeded - it is the stale/under-propagated value.

residual_uncertainty: The scenario definition (roster composition, target armor, fight length) lives in scripts//tests/, which this oracle is forbidden to read, so the target armor is pinned only to the band 119-131 that makes 1.2 the correct 2-dp rounding. Within that whole band the 5-stack answer rounds to 1.2 and the 1-stack answer rounds to 1.03, so the verdict does not depend on the exact champion.

If the coupled per-event field were meant to carry the fight-AVERAGED Carve strength rather than the instantaneous debuff, docs/math-foundations.md sec 2.3 (S6) would put it at 0.8*5 = 4 stacks = 24% -> ~1.15, and the exact Cesaro mean at h=46 hits (28.7%) -> ~1.19. Both of those are far closer to 1.2 than to 1.03, and the doc itself calls the 0.8 constant 'a documented tuning constant, not a theorem'. Under every stack model except literally-one-stack, the leaf lands in 1.15-1.20; nothing supports 1.03 at this event index.
verdict_rationale: 1.2 is the wiki-exact value of (100+R)/(100+0.7R) for a full 5-stack Carve (30% armor reduction, S1) against a level-18/20 champion target, using the engine's own m(R) and percent-reduction composition (S4, S5). 1.03 is the same formula at a single 6% stack, which cannot be the state of the debuff 46 events into the fight.
